ideas.idea: Give each product its own page/URL, linked from /shop and added to the sitemap
ideas.why: /shop only has one line of text and a single-product JSON-LD, so separate crawlable product pages would help discovery and understanding.

ideas.idea: Add a delivery/returns page explaining terms and regions
ideas.why: The home page claims next-day shipping and the layout mentions free delivery over £50, but no page explains terms, so a delivery page would answer real questions.
Accurate (the sitemap has no lastmod), but it only helps if the dates are real and it has little effect on a two-URL site.

ideas.idea: Add Organization/WebSite JSON-LD in the layout
ideas.why: The repo has no site-identity structured data, and the layout is a single place to add it for all pages.

ideas.idea: Add the brand name to the /shop title
ideas.why: The /shop title is 'Shop all parts' with no brand, while the home title includes 'Quay'.

ideas.idea: Use <main> instead of the bare <div> in app.html
ideas.why: app.html wraps the body in a plain <div> and there is no <main> landmark anywhere, so adding one helps machines and assistive tech find the main content.

ideas.idea: Add a viewport meta tag to app.html
ideas.why: app.html has only the charset meta, so mobile rendering lacks a viewport declaration.
/search is deliberately noindex, and the report itself concedes a description is optional there.
The report suggests it and then says leaving it out is fine, so it is not a real recommendation. If counted, it also pushes against the deliberate noindex choice.

ideas.idea: Block or decide on GPTBot/ClaudeBot training crawlers in robots.txt
ideas.why: It is accurate that they are not blocked, but the report treats it as unscored and offers only a policy choice, not a fix.
